title: addyosmani/agent-skills
title_zh: Agent Skills 生产级工程技能

paragraphs.en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 面向 AI 编程智能体的生产级工程技能。

paragraphs.en: Skills encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices that senior engineers use when building software. These ones are packaged so AI agents follow them consistently across every phase of development.
paragraphs.zh: 技能将资深工程师在构建软件时所使用的工作流程、质量关卡和最佳实践进行编码固化。 这些技能被打包起来，使智能体在开发的每个阶段都能一致地遵循它们。

paragraphs.en: In Claude Code these install as plugin commands. Where a built-in command has the same name, as /review does, use the namespaced form: /agent-skills:review .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code 中，这些会安装为插件命令。 当内置命令重名时（例如 /review），请使用带命名空间的形式：/agent-skills:review。

paragraphs.en: Want fewer manual steps once the spec exists? /build auto generates the plan and implements every task in a single approved pass — you approve the plan once, then it runs autonomously. It removes the human stepping between tasks, not the verification: every task is still test-driven and committed individually, and it pauses on failures or risky steps.
paragraphs.zh: 规格确定后想要更少的手动步骤？/build 会自动生成计划，并在一次获批流程中实现每个任务——你只需批准一次计划，之后它就自主运行。 它移除的是任务之间的人工干预，而不是验证：每个任务仍然由测试驱动并逐个提交，遇到失败或有风险的步骤时会暂停。

paragraphs.en: Skills also activate automatically based on what you're doing — designing an API triggers api-and-interface-design , building UI triggers frontend-ui-engineering , and so on.
paragraphs.zh: 技能还会根据你正在做的事情自动激活——设计 API 时会触发 api-and-interface-design，构建 UI 时会触发 frontend-ui-engineering，依此类推。

paragraphs.en: npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills # install all 25 skills npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --list # browse before installing Or grab individual skills:
paragraphs.zh:
npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills # 安装全部 25 个技能
npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --list # 安装前先浏览
或者单独获取各个技能：

paragraphs.en: npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --skill code-review-and-quality # five-axis review before merge npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --skill interview-me # requirements interrogation, one question at a time npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --skill test-driven-development # red-green-refactor, enforced Installing one skill? A per-skill npx install copies only skills/<name>/ , not the repo-level references/ directory. The skill still works, but paths to supplementary shared checklists are unavailable. Use a whole-repo integration, clone the repository, or copy the needed checklist into a references/ directory inside the installed skill. This portability gap is tracked in #361 .
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --skill code-review-and-quality # 合并前进行五维审查 npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --skill interview-me # 需求追问，一次只问一个问题 npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --skill test-driven-development # 红-绿-重构，强制执行 只安装一个技能？ 按技能执行 npx 安装只会复制 skills/<name>/ 目录，而不会复制仓库级的 references/ 目录。 该技能仍然可用，但指向补充性共享检查清单的路径将不可用。 请使用整个仓库集成、克隆仓库，或将所需的检查清单复制到已安装技能内部的 references/ 目录中。 这一可移植性缺口已在 #361 中跟踪。

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills /plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills SSH errors? The marketplace clones repos via SSH. If you don't have SSH keys set up on GitHub, either add your SSH key or use the full HTTPS URL to force HTTPS cloning during the marketplace-add step:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills /plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills 遇到 SSH 错误？ 该市场通过 SSH 克隆仓库。 如果你在 GitHub 上尚未配置 SSH 密钥，可以在添加市场这一步添加你的 SSH 密钥，或使用完整的 HTTPS URL 来强制进行 HTTPS 克隆：

sents.en: /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills /plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills SSH errors?
sents.zh: /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills /plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills 遇到 SSH 错误？

sents.en: The marketplace clones repos via SSH.
sents.zh: 该市场通过 SSH 克隆仓库。

sents.en: If you don't have SSH keys set up on GitHub, either add your SSH key or use the full HTTPS URL to force HTTPS cloning during the marketplace-add step:
sents.zh: 如果你在 GitHub 上尚未配置 SSH 密钥，可以在添加市场这一步添加你的 SSH 密钥，或使用完整的 HTTPS URL 来强制进行 HTTPS 克隆：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills.git /plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills If /plugin install still fails with git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey) on Windows or macOS, the recommended workaround is to configure Git once to rewrite GitHub SSH URLs to HTTPS for subprocess clones:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills.git /plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills 如果在 Windows 或 macOS 上，/plugin install 仍然失败并报错 git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey)，推荐的解决方法是配置 Git 一次性将 GitHub 的 SSH URL 重写为 HTTPS，用于子进程克隆：

paragraphs.en: Install as a native Codex plugin (Codex CLI v0.122+):
paragraphs.zh: 以原生 Codex 插件形式安装（Codex CLI v0.122+）：

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills codex plugin add agent-skills@agent-skills The first command registers the marketplace; the second installs the plugin. Codex reads the root skills/ directory directly through .codex-plugin/plugin.json . Once installed, invoke skills in chat using @ (e.g., @spec-driven-development ). See docs/codex-setup.md for local installation and troubleshooting.
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills codex plugin add agent-skills@agent-skills 第一条命令用于注册市场；第二条命令用于安装插件。 Codex 通过 .codex-plugin/plugin.json 直接读取根目录下的 skills/ 目录。 安装完成后，可在聊天中使用 @ 来调用技能（例如 @spec-driven-development）。 本地安装与故障排除请参见 docs/codex-setup.md。

paragraphs.en: cmd skills add addyosmani/agent-skills # pick skills to install (project) cmd skills add addyosmani/agent-skills --global # install for all projects (~/.commandcode/skills/) cmd skills add addyosmani/agent-skills -s spec-driven-development # install a specific skill Installed skills show up in the TUI slash menu, e.g. /spec-driven-development . See docs/commandcode-setup.md .

paragraphs.en: Every skill follows a consistent anatomy:

paragraphs.en: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ SKILL.md │ │ │ │ ┌─ Frontmatter ─────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ name: lowercase-hyphen-name │ │ │ │ description: Guides agents through [task].│ │ │ │ Use when… │ │ │ └───────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ │ Overview → What this skill does │ │ When to Use → Triggering conditions │ │ Process → Step-by-step workflow │ │ Rationalizations → Excuses + rebuttals │ │ Red Flags → Signs something's wrong │ │ Verification → Evidence requirements │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ Key design choices:

The portable core stays in shared directories. Host-specific paths are native discovery conventions, not branding aliases; renaming or merging them would break the tools that scan those exact locations.

paragraphs.en: AI coding agents default to the shortest path - which often means skipping specs, tests, security reviews, and the practices that make software reliable. Agent Skills gives agents structured workflows that enforce the same discipline senior engineers bring to production code.
paragraphs.zh: AI 编码智能体默认走最短路径——这往往意味着跳过规格说明、测试、安全审查，以及那些让软件可靠的各种实践。 Agent Skills 为智能体提供结构化的工作流，强制执行资深工程师在生产代码中所遵循的同样纪律。

paragraphs.en: Each skill encodes hard-won engineering judgment: when to write a spec, what to test, how to review, and when to ship. These aren't generic prompts - they're the kind of opinionated, process-driven workflows that separate production-quality work from prototype-quality work.
paragraphs.zh: 每个技能都凝结了来之不易的工程判断：什么时候写规格说明、测试什么内容、如何做评审，以及什么时候发布。 这些不是通用的提示词——而是那种有明确主张、以流程驱动的工作流，正是它们把生产级的成果与原型级的成果区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Skills bake in best practices from Google's engineering culture — including concepts from Software Engineering at Google and Google's engineering practices guide . You'll find Hyrum's Law in API design, the Beyonce Rule and test pyramid in testing, change sizing and review speed norms in code review, Chesterton's Fence in simplification, trunk-based development in git workflow, Shift Left and feature flags in CI/CD, and a dedicated deprecation skill treating code as a liability. These aren't abstract principles — they're embedded directly into the step-by-step workflows agents follow.
paragraphs.zh: Skills 技能中融入了 Google 工程文化中的最佳实践——包括《Software Engineering at Google》和 Google 工程实践指南中的理念。 你会在 API 设计中看到 Hyrum 定律，在测试中看到 Beyonce 规则和测试金字塔，在代码评审中看到变更规模和评审速度规范，在简化中看到 Chesterton 围栏，在 git 工作流中看到基于主干开发，在 CI/CD 中看到左移和特性开关，还有一个专门的弃用技能将代码视为负债。 这些不是抽象原则——它们直接嵌入到智能体所遵循的分步工作流中。

paragraphs.en: Skills should be specific (actionable steps, not vague advice), verifiable (clear exit criteria with evidence requirements), battle-tested (based on real workflows), and minimal (only what's needed to guide the agent).
paragraphs.zh: 技能应当是具体的（可执行的步骤，而非模糊的建议）、可验证的（明确的退出标准及证据要求）、经过实战检验的（基于真实工作流程），并且是精简的（仅保留引导智能体所需的内容）。

paragraphs.en: See docs/skill-anatomy.md for the format specification, CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines, and docs/advanced-per-agent-configuration.md for applying model routing, tool restrictions, and other per-agent runtime controls without breaking the portable SKILL.md frontmatter.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 docs/skill-anatomy.md 了解格式规范，CONTRIBUTING.md 了解贡献指南，以及 docs/advanced-per-agent-configuration.md 了解如何在不破坏可移植的 SKILL.md frontmatter 的情况下应用模型路由、工具限制和其他针对每个智能体的运行时控制。
